notes.title: Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉
notes.content:
[h3]Get your survival skills ready - Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]Hello Survivors!  

We are happy to announce that our new game [b]Frost Survival VR [/b]has just launched on Steam!

Frost Survival VR is a sandbox survival set in a frozen wilderness. Face a frozen wilderness solo or in co-op - build a shelter, craft tools, hunt for food, and manage your resources to endure harsh conditions. Strategize your moves against unpredictable weather and lurking dangers. And remember to keep yourself safe and sane![/p][p][/p][h3]Play the game now!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054950/Frost_Survival_VR/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p]We encourage you to join our community on [url="https://discord.gg/wenklystudio"]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wenklystudio"]TikTok[/url], X and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/FrostSurvivalVR/"]Reddit[/url].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Needs & Survival 🏹[/b][/h3][p]Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wits and limited resources to survive harsh conditions in this [b]Sandbox Survival. [/b]Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?[/p][p][b]Build your Base[/b]: Build a shelter to escape the frost and replenish vital strengths.[/p][p][b]Tools & Weapons[/b]: To survive and fully exploit your surroundings, you will need a variety of tools.[/p][p][b]Hunt, Craft & Gather[/b]: Hunt wild animals to gain food and resources.  [/p][h3][b]
Winter & Wilderness❄️ [/b][/h3][p]Surviving isn't easy. Strategizing your moves is crucial to staying alive. Complete essential tasks during daylight and be aware of the darkness, as nighttime brings [b]lower temperatures[/b]. [b]Weather conditions[/b] are unpredictable and change dynamically, so always be prepared!  Explore a [b]huge map[/b], but remember that not every place is safe; some may be inaccessible based on your current gear.[b] [/b][/p][h3][b]
Safe & Sane 👾 [/b][/h3][p]Survival isn’t just about staying alive; it’s also about [b]staying sane[/b]. How do you keep your humanity in this frozen hell?[/p][p]In Frost Survival VR, you must take care of not only your physiological needs, such as hunger, thirst, and keeping yourself warm, but also your [b]mental health[/b]. If you neglect it, reality may start to blur with illusion. [b]Fake sounds[/b] and [b]creatures[/b] will make survival even more challenging. But beware - some figments of your imagination can harm you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Multiplayer Experience👥[/b][/h3][p] Try to survive [b]alone[/b] or [b]cooperate[/b] with others in a multiplayer experience.[/p][p]Do you like playing alone? Don’t worry, there are some uncovered secrets scattered across the frozen wilderness that will help you endure. Or you can work together with other players: gather resources, insulate your shelter, and defend against threats like cold, hunger, and dangerous animals. [b]Shape your survival sandbox experience your way! [/b] [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/shared/images/responsive/youtube_16x9_placeholder.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Astro Hunters VR releases on August 8th!👨‍🚀
notes.content:
[h2]Astro Hunters VR is set to launch August 8th!👨‍🚀[/h2]

Hello Survivors!

We are happy to announce that our new game [b]Astro Hunters VR[/b] launches on Steam on [b] August 8th at 7PM CEST[/b]! 🌌🎮

Astro Hunters VR is a [b]PvPvE Extraction Shooter[/b] set in space. Immerse yourself in the exploration of a unique planet, fight with different enemies, craft, gather resources, and upgrade your weapons. 
Become one of the mercenaries and help the Mothership. We’re waiting for you! But remember there are also other hunters on the planet. Will you ally, fight, or betray - it's up to you!🚀

To celebrate the launch, we have some fantastic offer for early supporters:
👨‍🚀-10% Discount👨‍🚀 

🔔Add the game to your wishlist to get notified once the game is out: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/

[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=Vh1uVNN-OzA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🚀The Hunt Begins[/h3]
Undertake dangerous missions and challenge other players and in exchange freely scavenge the planets. You can join forces with other players, but be careful, hunting down other players to seize their valuable equipment is also an option! Going on an expedition comes with a high reward if you find valuable items, but it’s also high risk - if you die, you lose everything!

[h3]🔨Gather Resources and Craft[/h3]
Collect resources such as gases, liquids, metals, and others on different planets. Each of the resources has its special gathering tool. Use the collected items to craft new and better equipment. The Mothership provides you with crafting stations, on which you can craft inhalers, weapon parts, ammo and more. Do you want to store them, sell for good money, or trade with other players? The choice is yours!

[h3]🔫Manage and Upgrade your Equipment[/h3]
Gather a diverse range of weapons: pistols, rifles, rocket launchers, machine guns, shotguns, and snipers. Upgrade stats and customize them with elemental modifications: fire, plasma, electricity, and acid. Beware of other players lurking on the planets for your loot. To avoid being left with nothing, store some of them in your storage room to be ready for your next expedition.

✍️We are looking forward to your reviews and feedback. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.

Join our amazing community in our [url=discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/AstroHuntersVR]X[/url] to share your experience and get to know Hunters

Enjoy the game!

[b]Wenkly Studio Team[/b]

notes.title: Refreshed Development Roadmap! New Winter map coming soon❄️
notes.content:
Hello Survivors! 🧟

As some of you might have seen in the UploadVR Showcase, we announced that the Winter Map is coming! 

That is why, today we are coming to show you the refreshed roadmap of our achievements and updates completed so far in 2023 (seen on the left side) and on the right side, our plans for further game development.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43242008/d1acb47336dd0da883a70ae45ae6af82c03c1b5e.jpg[/img]

We received all the feedback you have been sharing with us, so for those who were asking about a new map, new quests, and new stuff to do - it should be great news. The new map will enable you to progress even more by completing completely new quests and exploring different scenery.

Apart from that big news, as you can see, we also want to introduce an improved weapon system with more mechanics in general, improved enemy combat, and as many of you asked for - the possibility of selling weapons.

But, that does not mean that’s it. There will definitely be more things added that are currently not certain.

Last but not least, we want to say a big THANK YOU for your continuous support! All suggestions and remarks you share are greatly appreciated! As always, if you have any more ideas, do not hesitate to share them, as we will be adding community feedback improvements. 

For those who didn't see the show, here is the video with our announcements: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FY2L771PUs0] Survival Nation[/url]

- [b]Now sprint is activated automatically[/b] – Removed automatic sprint option from settings. We've listened to your feedback and made sprinting easy by introducing automatic sprint activation
- Added patch notes screen – Now a player can see what is new in the game
- Fixed the issue that a player cannot craft higher-level cocktails

notes.title: Post-Launch Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Post-Launch Improvements[/h1]

Hello everyone! We have just released a new patch including a few fixes and implementations, so your game experience is even more pleasant! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43242008/93161532737c6c310182e167715add66d62c7a16.png[/img]
Firstly, we introduce you to some changes that we have made:
- Now after switching the movement controller to the right, clicking the right thumbstick will activate sprint, not magazine ejection.
- Fixed the wrong number of gathered items on notification
- Fixed broken notification about quest rewards after completing a few quests in a row
- Fixed button icons in the Chinese language
- Fixed bug that player could have a black screen after going into beach umbrellas
- Fixed that wrong controller buttons could be displayed after the dominant hand or movement controller change

What is more, this patch also includes a few fixes and adjustments from the Beta 1.0.2 patch notes which included:

- Added option to switch movement controller independent from dominant hand option. Also, we are still working on more customization for the left-handed and displaying everywhere proper button icons.
- Fixed bug that the player after placing campfire and rejoining the server couldn't see other player models
- Fixed missing hit impact particle on the ground
- Fixed problem with "Find something" quests that were impossible to complete because of insufficient items or the player cannot grab these items
- Fixed some problems with Quest Marker: disappearing marker, showing wrong way or distance
- Fixed infinite black/loading screen after trying to join to room
- Improved size and position of colliders preventing players to reach not permitted places to be less invasive
- Made easier to grab parts of a weapon while reloading
- Fixed some desynchronization problems (e.g. an item sometimes was not visible in other player's hands)
- Added a little offset while scrolling inventory to make it more comfortable
- Changed melee weapon mechanic. Now the damage is scalable depending on hit power
- Fixed some performance spikes
- Fixed stuttering issues on some devices, especially on display rate > 72Hz. We are still working on it, but we wanted to make a game even a little more comfortable for you as soon as possible
- Optimized Junkyard location
- Changed tents texture
- Side activities should be counted properly (e.g. climbing activity progress 14/15 after reaching all climbing spots). It is not fixed for players that completed a specific climbing spot but will be fixed in the future.
- Fixed a bug that caused reloading certain weapons, such as the BA1891, to use double the number of bullets

notes.title: Post-Launch Improvements Beta
notes.content:
[h1]Post-Launch Improvements Beta[/h1]

Hi! 
We have released a new patch for the beta channel. 
We fixed some bugs and issues that were happening to you, and made some changes to make the game more comfortable. 
(Instructions how to install Beta below)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43242008/cc4d47cea931a22456c5d33f7da2e19c89a734fb.png[/img]

- Added option to switch movement controller independent from dominant hand option. Also, we are still working on more customization for the left-handed and displaying everywhere proper button icons.
- Fixed bug that the player after placing campfire and rejoining the server couldn't see other player models
- Fixed missing hit impact particle on the ground
- Fixed problem with "Find something" quests that were impossible to complete because of insufficient items or the player cannot grab these items
- Fixed some problems with Quest Marker: disappearing marker, showing wrong way or distance
- Fixed infinite black/loading screen after trying to join to room
- Improved size and position of colliders preventing players to reach not permitted places to be less invasive
- Made easier to grab parts of a weapon while reloading
- Fixed some desynchronization problems (e.g. an item sometimes was not visible in other player's hands)
- Added a little offset while scrolling inventory to make it more comfortable
- Changed melee weapon mechanic. Now the damage is scalable depending on hit power
- Fixed some performance spikes
- Fixed stuttering issues on some devices, especially on display rate > 72Hz. We are still working on it, but we wanted to make a game even a little more comfortable for you as soon as possible
- Optimized Junkyard location
- Changed tents texture
- Side activities should be counted properly (e.g. climbing activity progress 14/15 after reaching all climbing spots). It is not fixed for players that completed a specific climbing spot but will be fixed in the future.
- Fixed a bug that caused reloading certain weapons, such as the BA1891, to use double the number of bullets


Have fun and let us know what you think of the update. If you encounter any problems, also contact us. We look forward to your feeback!


[h2]How to play the Beta version?[/h2]
[b]Please note that the Beta version is only able to play with the Beta version. This means that if another player has a different version of the game than you, you will not be able to play together.[/b]

1. Right-click on Survival Nation
2. Click "Properties"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43242008/8f6d802ab1fbca777a5e33afe3a4c9afe1d72829.png[/img]

3. Choose "Betas"
4. Select the Beta version from the list. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43242008/f990e9ff5927ba2d1804fd7ee93f3763cb1584bc.png[/img]

5. Steam will automatically download the changes.
